heading: Retain key information on the home screen, separate other data onto secondary page.
eyebrow: 🤔 But wait...Do we need to put all the data on the homepage?

blocks.html: After analyzing the content drivers care about on the homepage, a question arose: Do we need to display all data information on the homepage? It seems to lack focus and can overwhelm drivers. So, instead of putting all the data on the homepage, I eventually decided to present only the most critical data, namely the delivery rate, and then distribute the other data to secondary pages.

blocks.alt: Espoirer — Retain key information on the home screen, separate other data onto secondary page.
